summary: v56n PREVIEW verification of the 17 P0/P1 bugs from the production bug sheet. No app code was changed. Backend: new pytest file (16 tests: 11 pass, 4 fail, 1 skip; the 4 failures are real bugs). Frontend: Playwright flows run as admin, vendor and escrow-staff. RESULT: P0 18 PASS, 67 PASS, 72 PASS (no crash, but the error text is the raw 404 message), 41 PASS (no crash), 60 PASS. P1 15 PASS, 43 PASS, 45 PASS, 13 PASS (with caveat); 56 PARTIAL FAIL, 55 FAIL, 17 FAIL, 44 FAIL, 23/37 FAIL, 36 FAIL, 58 FAIL, 40 FAIL.

per_bug_results.18_P0_admin_evaluation: PASS - /admin/e/evaluation loads with no ErrorBoundary. The picker finds 16/55/18, and the RubricEditor and bid list render. award-report-btn shows the [data-testid=award-report] table for 0016, 0055 and 0018. No crash, no page errors.
per_bug_results.67_P0_audit_masters: PASS - /admin/e/audit lists ledger rows (latest 500, 20 per page). /admin/e/masters renders 16 tabs (Staff, Companies, Tenants, Approval Matrix, Hierarchy, Rating & Fees, Charge Fee, Categories, Currencies, Legal entity types, Country licenses, Geography, Vendor requests, Profile changes, EMD rules, Investor Demo); all were clicked with no crash.
per_bug_results.72_P0_escrow_magic_link: PASS (no crash) - /escrow/officer/<invalid> renders the Escrow Officer Portal shell with an error box. MINOR FAIL on UX: it shows the raw axios text 'Request failed with status code 404' (EscrowOfficerSign.jsx load() uses setError(e.message)) instead of a friendly 'link invalid/expired'. The valid-token path needs seed data.
per_bug_results.41_P0_escrow_bid_flow: PASS (no crash) - no errors on /admin/e/escrow, /admin/e/bidding (tabs pmc/supplier/awarded/all), /admin/e/escrow-institutions or the staff escrow portal (Overview, Escrow signatures, EMD paid, Completed). Accept & forward was NOT clicked because it changes a real vendor bid. Minor: the EMD-paid card shows 'Manual Preview Vendor Pvt Ltd - 0' (amount 0); most Joint Escrow Accounts say 'institution not set'; unified staff login fires a 403 POST /api/v1/staff/auth/login before it succeeds.
per_bug_results.60_P0_reverse_auction: PASS - creating from the UI works (toast 'Auction drafted'). Start at 0/2 shows a clear 400 toast ('need at least 2 registered participants'). Start at 2/2 flips the row to LIVE with a Close button. The vendor room /vendor/auction/<id> shows ra-bid-price, Place bid and auto-bid. Caveat: Start needs 2 or more REGISTERED participants, and invited vendors who have not accepted do not count, which is probably why prod reports 'Start does nothing'. Minor: /vendor/auctions did not list an auction the vendor joined via /register (not invited).
per_bug_results.56_P1_ai_fill_all: PARTIAL FAIL - a 3-section template filled in 10.7s (updated=3, real HTML). An 18-section template returned HTTP 502 at 60s (ingress timeout), but the backend finished about 1-2 minutes later and saved all 18 sections. The user sees an error, or a stale doc. RCA: tender_pro.py ai_fill_all_sections makes N LLM calls one after another inside a single request.
per_bug_results.15_P1_registration_approve: PASS - a fully filled, seeded, submitted registration was approved from the UI. Toast 'Approval recorded'; after refresh it is gone from Submitted and shows under Approved (status approved, vendor_ref minted).
per_bug_results.55_P1_registration_some_fail: FAIL - all 30 submitted/needs_clarification registrations in preview return 400 on approve: 'Cannot approve - missing Section A fields: registered_address, registration_number, legal_entity_type'. Clarify (6/6) and reject work. RCA: POST /registrations/{id}/submit only checks declarations and signature, not the Section A fields that approve requires, so un-approvable registrations can be submitted. Also, registrations with created_via=admin_full_form never store those fields and already have a vendor_ref, so approve hits the 400 now and would then hit a 409 duplicate vendor.
per_bug_results.17_P1_docusign_vendor_status: FAIL - the vendor /vendor/signatures shows 'Nothing to sign yet'. RCA: in docusign.py list_my_envelopes (L1053-1057) bids are read with projection {id,vendor_id} and only kept if b.get('id'). No bid document has an 'id' field (0 of 12), so bid_ids is always empty. Vendors only see envelopes where signer_email equals their email, and preview envelopes have signer_email=kannan@emeraldcorporates.com. Fix: use str(b['_id']). Two envelopes are stuck at 'sent' and need DocuSign sync. The full sign flow needs seed data (an awarded bid for manualvendor plus a DocuSign sandbox signature).
per_bug_results.44_P1_scoring_zero: FAIL - if no rubric is saved for a notice, the award report uses empty criteria, so technical_avg is 0 and the report says 'No bid qualifies (all below 60% cutoff)'. Reproduced on PMC-NOT-2026-0018: score {'experience':80} exists, but Tech% shows 0. The UI shows DEFAULT_CRITERIA, which are never saved unless the admin clicks Save rubric. Also, _load_rubric_config uses 'or 0.4' / 'or 60.0', so commercial_weight=0 becomes 0.4 and minimum_technical=0 becomes 60. COI auto-declare was checked by code review only: the candidate notice 0016 has its technical envelope locked (needs seed data: an unlocked notice with bids).
per_bug_results.43_P1_rubric_persist: PASS - Minimum technical cutoff changed 60 to 65, saved (toast 'Rubric saved'), page reloaded and notice re-picked: shows 65 (then restored to 60). API save then GET also persists. Minor: loadRubric does not reset to defaults when you switch to a notice with no rubric, so the previous notice's values carry over.
per_bug_results.45_P1_contracts_listed: PASS - BOQ & contracts > Contracts tab lists contracts. A contract created via API (PMC-CON-2026-0007) appears in GET /contracts. Minor: contract_seq is incremented before the awarded-bid check, which leaves gaps in reference numbers.
per_bug_results.23_37_P1_corrigenda: FAIL (partial) - publish, public list and Diff PDF (200 application/pdf) work, and the deadline / key dates update. Remaining bugs: (a) clicking the public Corrigenda tab triggers PmcLinkPatcher (L130-160), which shows 'No Corrigenda section published on this notice' because the React corrigenda block is not a .dt-sec, so users get a message that contradicts the corrigenda below. (b) corrigenda.py publish_corrigendum inserts the corrigendum (L316) and updates the notice deadline (L323) BEFORE require_future / _validate_tender_chain. A 400 response still leaves an ACTIVE public corrigendum and a moved deadline; reproduced 4 times on PMC-NOT-2026-0102. (c) NoticeDetailE has hardcoded ledger refs 'notice.publish #1872 / corrigendum.issue #1880' (L209) and hardcoded tab counts Documents 5 / Clarifications 2 (L179).
per_bug_results.36_P1_closed_tender_start_bid: FAIL - for a logged-in vendor, closed notices PMC-NOT-2026-0102 and 0016 still show an active 'Start bid' link to /vendor/workspace/new?notice=..., and the countdown reads '0m'. RCA: NoticeDetailE.jsx L172 and L197 render the Start bid <Link> with no deadline or status check.
per_bug_results.13_P1_vendor_invite_email: PASS (with caveat) - POST /vendors/invite to a deliverable address returns email_sent:true (Resend 200). For @example.com addresses Resend returns 422 ('use our testing email address') and the API returns email_sent:false. verify_url in preview points at https://pmcmanagers.com (FRONTEND_URL config).
per_bug_results.58_P1_catalog_disable: FAIL - clicking Disable shows the toast 'Toggle failed - HTTP 422 Field required Field required Field required'. RCA: ProductCatalogPanel.jsx L328 sends a partial body {is_active} to PATCH /api/v1/products/{id}, which expects the full ProductIn (code, name and category required).
per_bug_results.40_P1_notice_timeline: FAIL - the Key dates block in NoticeDetailE.jsx (L202-208) is hardcoded mock data (Published 21 Sep 2026, Corrigendum 1 26 Sep, Clarifications 27 Sep, Bid closes 30 Sep 2026 21:48, Tech open 1 Oct) that pmcELiveData.js overwrites at runtime. On PMC-NOT-2026-0055 (real deadline 2030-01-01, published_at null) the mock dates stay on screen and the countdown shows 'Closes in 0m'. The patcher also only fills the 6 fixed rows, so with more than 2 corrigenda plus clarification/pre-bid dates, later items (including 'Bid submission closes') are cut off. Dates were correct on 0100 and 0101.

critical.issue: Inserts the corrigendum and updates the notice deadline BEFORE the date validation. A 400 response still publishes an active corrigendum and moves submission_deadline.
Matching envelopes to bids never works: bids have no 'id' field, so bid_ids is always empty and vendors do not see their award envelopes.
With no saved rubric, criteria are empty and every technical score computes to 0. A weight or cutoff of 0 is replaced by the default ('or 0.4' / 'or 60').
LLM calls run one after another in a single request. Templates with about 18 sections exceed the 60s ingress timeout (502), while the backend keeps working and saves later.

minor.issue: Does not check the Section A fields that approve requires, so submitted registrations can never be approved (bug 55).
Requires the full ProductIn body, so the UI's partial is_active toggle gets a 422.
contract_seq is incremented before validation, which leaves gaps in reference numbers.
email_sent:false is returned silently when Resend rejects the address; the response gives no reason.

ui_bugs.issue: Enabled on closed or expired notices.
The Corrigenda tab shows 'No Corrigenda section published' even when corrigenda exist.
Hardcoded mock dates remain when the live patch does not apply (0055); the timeline is limited to 6 rows.
An invalid token shows the raw 'Request failed with status code 404' instead of an 'invalid/expired link' state.

integration_issues.issue: The vendor never sees award envelopes (backend /docusign/mine bug).
Large templates show an error (502) even though the backend later fills every section.

issues: Native browser date inputs (mm/dd/yyyy) used instead of the shadcn Calendar picker
Hardcoded ledger refs #1872/#1880 and tab counts (Documents 5, Clarifications 2)
Countdown 'Closes in 0m' on closed notices instead of a Closed label

action_items: Bug 58: ProductCatalogPanel onToggle should send the full product, or add a partial ProductPatchIn (exclude_unset), or call DELETE /products/{id} for disable.
Bug 36: hide or disable Start bid in NoticeDetailE (L172, L197) when submission_deadline < now or the notice status is closed/awarded; show a 'Bidding closed' label.

Bug 23/37: in corrigenda.publish_corrigendum, run require_future and _validate_tender_chain BEFORE insert_one and the notice update_one. Fix the PmcLinkPatcher Corrigenda tab so it scrolls to #notice-e-corrigenda (or treat it as a .dt-sec) instead of showing the 'No Corrigenda section' note.
Bug 17: in docusign.list_my_envelopes use str(b['_id']) for bid_ids (projection {'_id':1,'vendor_id':1}).
Bug 44: award_report should fall back to DEFAULT_CRITERIA when no rubric exists, or auto-save the rubric on first score. Replace 'or 0.4' / 'or 60.0' with explicit None checks.
Bug 56: move ai-fill-all to a background job with polling (like dpr/analyze-async), or run sections in parallel with asyncio.gather and a concurrency limit.

Bug 55: enforce the Section A required fields (registered_address, registration_number, legal_entity_type) on /submit, or show missing fields in the admin card before Approve; handle admin_full_form registrations that already have a vendor_ref.
Bug 40: remove the hardcoded Key-dates JSX and render it from notice data in React; drop the 6-row limit.
Bug 72 (minor): show a friendly 'link invalid or expired' message on 404/410 in EscrowOfficerSign.
critical_code_review_comments: PmcLinkPatcher.jsx (1086 lines) and pmcELiveData.js change the React-rendered DOM imperatively. This is the root cause of the contradictory Corrigenda note and the stale mock Key dates. Prefer real React state.
NoticeDetailE.jsx contains static mock content (dates, ledger ids, tab counts) that only a DOM patch overwrites, so wrong data appears whenever the patch does not apply.
EvaluationPanel.loadRubric keeps the previous notice's rubric when the new notice has none (stale weights).
corrigenda.py publish: the side effects (insert, notice update) run before validation, so the write is not atomic.
